_comment: Batch 005 -- the Check, produced, and its four states.
The four state shots share ONE camera on purpose: an orbit at a fixed
target and radius, not `frame`, because `frame` solves its distance
from the subject's own box and four subjects of four sizes would each
get a different lens-to-subject distance. A comparison sheet whose
frames were taken from four distances compares the distances.
The far read is 1920x1080 because `art_budgets.json` states the
Check's 35 px at 39.6 m against a 1080p screen. Shot at 810 lines it
would be 26 px and the sheet would be quietly answering a different

shots.name: K_check_assembled
shots.caption: THE CHECK, ASSEMBLED - MAST, ITEM, DESTINATION RING
shots.note: THREE SEPARATE GLBS. REWARD.GD DRIVES ITEM AND RING APART

shots.name: K_check_operator
shots.caption: WALK-UP - THE INTERACTION FACE AT EYE HEIGHT, ENGINE LENS
shots.note: THE FACE IS A DIFFERENT TEXTURE FROM THE SHELL, ON PURPOSE

shots.name: K_check_far_read
shots.caption: 39.6 M - THE LARGEST ARENA DIAGONAL, AT THE ENGINE'S OWN LENS
shots.note: MAST 35 PX - RING 30 PX - ITEM 4 PX. THE RING IS THE DISTANCE CHANNEL

shots.name: K_state_family
shots.caption: THE FOUR STATES ON THE MAST - LOCKED / AVAILABLE / SENDING / CONFIRMED
shots.note: ONE CAMERA, ONE FRAME. THE COMPARISON THE SHEET EXISTS FOR

shots.name: K_state_family_far
shots.caption: THE SAME FOUR AT 39.6 M ON THE ENGINE'S LENS - 6 M APART
shots.note: DOES STATE READ ACROSS THE LARGEST ARENA? THE SHEET ANSWERS, NOT THE BUILDER

shots.name: K_state_locked
shots.caption: LOCKED - THE CRADLE IS EMPTY
shots.note: REWARD.GD: OBJECTIVE NOT SATISFIED. RING AT 0.35 ENERGY

shots.name: K_state_available
shots.caption: AVAILABLE - THE ONE BRIGHT STATE, IN SIGNAL TEAL
shots.note: THE LARGEST LIT AREA OF THE FOUR. NOTHING ELSE COMPETES

shots.name: K_state_sending
shots.caption: SENDING - STRETCHED TOWARD THE CAP, IN SEND AMBER
shots.note: SAME FAMILY AS THE RING AND THE BEAM: THIS LEAVES THE ROOM

shots.name: K_state_confirmed
shots.caption: CONFIRMED - A SMALL DARK HUSK IN THE CRADLE
shots.note: NOT CONFUSABLE WITH LOCKED: LOCKED IS EMPTY, THIS IS OCCUPIED

shots.name: K_check_cage_detail
shots.caption: THE CAGED HEAD - 20 MM CLEARANCE EACH SIDE, SO IT CAN SPIN
shots.note: EIGHT SIDES, NOT A SPUN DIAMOND: A DIAMOND SWEEPS ITS DIAGONAL

shots.name: K_item_family
shots.caption: THE FOUR STATES ALONE - LOCKED / AVAILABLE / SENDING / CONFIRMED
shots.note: FOUR SILHOUETTES, NOT FOUR HUES. HUE IS THE CHANNEL A PLAYER MAY NOT HAVE

shots.name: K_destination_ring
shots.caption: DESTINATION RING - REWARD.GD'S OWN RADII, 0.86 TO 1.02
shots.note: ONE FLAT MATERIAL: THE ENGINE TINTS IT PER RECIPIENT WORLD

shots.name: K_send_beam
shots.caption: SEND BEAM - 40 M, TAPERED 0.40 TO 0.18, EIGHT SIDES
shots.note: UNTEXTURED: 40 M AT 32 TEXELS/M WOULD WANT A 1280 MAP
